name: A Hero's Welcome
summary: General Shandris Feathermoon has asked to see you in person. Ginro Hearthkindle thinks she may thank you for aiding Feathermoon Stronghold and speak about the Zukk'ash insects you and Raschal met in southern Feralas.

sections.title: A Summons
sections.body: Ginro Hearthkindle says General Shandris Feathermoon is waiting in Feathermoon Stronghold's main compound. The reports about the Zukk'ash insects frighten him.

sections.title: At the General's Side
sections.body: General Shandris Feathermoon thanks you warmly for Feathermoon Stronghold and gives you a gift. She says your bravery against overwhelming odds deserves a thousand times more. A Zukk'ash hive has been found in Feralas, so she asks for your help again. She believes you are the best choice.

faq.q: Why does General Feathermoon want to see me?
faq.answer: Ginro expects General Shandris Feathermoon wants to thank you for your help and discuss the Zukk'ash insects you and Raschal met in southern Feralas.

faq.q: Who sends you to speak with Shandris Feathermoon?
faq.answer: Ginro Hearthkindle says General Shandris Feathermoon wants to see you in person.

faq.q: Where is General Shandris Feathermoon located?
faq.answer: General Shandris Feathermoon is waiting in the main compound of Feathermoon Stronghold.

faq.q: What is the concern about the Zukk'ash insects?
faq.answer: Ginro finds the reports about the Zukk'ash insects frightening, and General Shandris Feathermoon wants to discuss them with you.
